analysis.note: `uic` (added by #164) makes the transient start from a physically realizable initial condition -- every node at 0, EN low, the block disabled -- and power up through its own soft-start ramp when this testbench's EN edge arrives at 100us, rather than from an unconstrained ngspice operating-point solve. Without it (and with the pre-#164 DC-high EN), the `.op` that seeds the transient has no initial condition at all: on this same 200-draw sequence it emitted 61 solver warnings across 43 samples (`singular matrix` at xldo.fb / xldo.xr_fb_b.t2 / xldo.xr_cz.t1, `dynamic gmin stepping failed`), 3 samples produced no measurement, and 12 -- all but one of them NOT among the 43 warned-about draws -- settled with VOUT pinned at VIN and FB at 668-1984 V (one at 1.3e15 V) -- FB ABOVE the VOUT node that is the only thing feeding it through a passive resistor string, so not a circuit state. `sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po`'s voltco term (bp2=-0.1228, bq2=1.304) admits it: measured, one W=0.42/L=180um leg's modelled resistance falls 1.04Mohm -> 800ohm between 1V and 1800V and its fitted rbody multiplier crosses zero near 1.32kV (L=52um, R_CZ: ~440V). The state is reproducible with NOMINAL devices from a hostile `.nodeset`, so mismatch is not its trigger -- it only perturbs which branch Newton finds. With any physically realizable start (this `uic` bench; `uic` with EN DC-high; or an `.ic`-at-1.8V-seeded `.op`) all 200 draws regulate to within ~1uV of each other and no sample reports any solver diagnostic. See design/README.md "#164" for the four-variant screen; the 185 samples that already regulated move by at most 17uV (<10ppm).

measurements.name: vout_ss
measurements.note: Steady-state VOUT, averaged over the settled tail (2.5ms-3ms of a 3ms transient) of a fixed-1mA-load, VIN=3.3V/27C/tt_mm operating point, reached by powering the block up from its disabled state (EN edge at 100us, `uic`; see mc_analysis.note and #164) rather than from an unconstrained operating-point solve, which on 12 of these 200 draws was not a circuit state at all. Ratified bound: spec/target-spec.md "Output" row, 1.8V +-2% (ratified by issue #1 / DR-006).
measurements.spice: .meas tran vout_ss avg v(vout) from=2.5m to=3m
